# T-5: Update result consumers

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Migrate report and retro consumers to read v2 artifacts while keeping project regression separate from requirement aggregation.

## Acceptance Criteria
- report.json contains data.tests.projectRegression for completed v2 artifacts.
- Text report prints the specified Project regression line.
- report-show and finalize cleanup report envelopes use the same v2 report data and text.
- present unreadable or invalid test artifacts fail report/finalize report generation instead of being silently ignored.
- retro reads v2 summary line ranges and excludes regression from requirement totals.
- legacy state.test.summary aggregation is removed or quarantined so it cannot be used as v2 result authority.
- finalize commit, including executeCommitPost(), stages durable raw logs only, excludes temporary requirement summary artifacts, and does not swallow invalid artifact failures.

## Implementation Notes
Update run-report.js artifact loading, src/flow/commands/report.js formatting, run-report-show.js, run-finalize.js report generation, run-finalize-cleanup.js cleanup envelope handling, run-finalize-commit.js artifact staging, and flow-store summary handling so every report consumer uses the same v2 artifact data. Manual report after absent normal test-execute-result.json must hard fail instead of rendering issue-log as a substitute. executeCommitPost() must not catch invalid present test artifact failures as non-blocking report status.

## Test Strategy
Unit tests for report JSON/text output and retro aggregation with pass, fail, and required=false artifacts.
